question: Given an observer's coarse action sentence written after viewing a HoloAssist recording, can a frozen model retrieve the corresponding sequence of optical right-hand measurements from all eligible coarse intervals in that same recording, in unseen recording families?
claim_unit: Post-hoc within-recording, within-task segment retrieval. HoloLens tracks the wearer's hand. Neither past or future intent, brain activity, muscle activity, causality, real-time operation nor unseen people are identified.
source: Official HoloAssist hand data, action sentences and release splits. Source owner separately freezes recording selection, family grouping, geometry/measurement units, sampled times, missingness and a sealed reserve before any assessment fitting or scoring. Same task, scene and recording within all galleries; a family may have multiple recordings. R prefixes alone do not establish participant identity. No source test-set claim unless it actually is used.
unit: Use a gallery only with >=2 valid segments in the same recording after source eligibility. Collapse identical time intervals, merge their unique captions, in source order. For partially overlapping windows, keep earliest start, then earliest end, then key and skip intersections with already retained intervals. No exclusions for caption length, uncommon words, model outcome or difficulty. Freeze accounting of unusable rows. Fit and evaluate only separate whole-family partitions. Reserve payloads stay unopened.
motion: Only measured geometry, fixed-phase samples, and no timestamp, task, identifiers, source verb/noun, caption, ordinal, duration, or explicit missingness flag in the motion encoder. Standardize each measured channel by the mean and population SD of training observations alone (floor <=1e-6 uses scale 1). Zero-impute unobserved standardized features; evaluate detection-only controls. Freeze source-specific feature adapter after source agreement, before assessment. Local coordinate/distance geometry is required to avoid room origin identification.
text: Reuse the reviewed lowercased ASCII word/number tokenizer. Up to 32 tokens. Keep <=512 training terms sorted by segment document frequency then alphabetical. Training-only smooth inverse document frequency, L2 normalization for ridge. Retain wholly unknown queries and record the count. Coarse action labels are text-derived diagnostic metadata only.
ridge: Fit TF-IDF text to geometry descriptors with ridge penalty 2, unpenalized intercept, equal total weight per segment divided across captions. Four descriptors per standardized channel (phase mean, population SD, mean absolute adjacent difference, endpoint change); z-score descriptor values using training only and score candidate descriptors by cosine. Fixed strong baseline.
attention: Two single-block encoders from the reviewed KIT study. Learned positions; normalized projections; width 32, four heads, two-times-width feedforward, zero dropout; normalized text and motion means. Train 30 epochs, AdamW lr 0.002, weight decay 0.01, temperature 0.13, seed 20261120. One gallery per optimizer step, seeded recording order per epoch and one randomly selected caption/segment. Symmetric contrastive loss, with identical selected tokenized captions treated as alternative positives within each training gallery. No assessment labels, hyperparameter search, early stopping or adaptation. Save final weights only.
baselines: Chance and task/recording identity tie all candidates. Fit same ridge to separate nuisance-only target vectors: duration = log1p seconds; context = normalized midpoint within the full recording; mask = per-phase per-channel observation flags; joint nuisance = concatenation, each block divided by sqrt of width after training-only standardization so missingness width does not dominate. Nuisance models rank by negative mean squared error from predicted candidate metadata. Fit an otherwise identical attention model with caption groups cyclically deranged within each training recording, seed 40362. Use geometry ridge and the real attention model on the same gallery.
metrics: Exact-segment recall at 1, recall at min(5,gallery size), expected reciprocal rank under uniform score-tie permutations. Average over captions within segment, segments within recording, recordings within family, then families equally. Report family values, each gallery size and chance via all-score ties. Diagnostics: exact normalized caption multiple positives; same (normalized) source coarse verb+noun candidate subgalleries with >=2 different segments; restrict separately to other segments carrying different normalized sentences if available. Those labels come from annotators; they never enter the motion input. Report right-hand coverage and text OOV counts.
copy_checks: Before interpreting estimates, compare training and assessment geometry (including mask separately) for exact equality and for near copies using RMS differences on common measured values standardized by training SD. Flag <=0.01 with >=75% common coverage and >=2 observed phases. Compare normalized full captions and token-set Jaccard >=0.8, recording/interval overlap, and duplicated sparse masks. Report all counts and an exact/near-text-novel query sensitivity with the originally fixed galleries intact. Prespecified geometry duplicate evidence crossing splits invalidates a held-out winner claim; do not replace items.
decision: Ridge is the predeclared normal-entry default, independent of assessment. Export both fitted geometrical models for explicit selection. A positive model comparison needs strictly higher family-macro recall@1 and MRR than chance, every nuisance control, and wrong pairing. An attention advantage additionally needs both to beat ridge. At least six assessment families and a positive lower endpoint on 95% family-cluster percentile bootstrap paired differences on both metrics against every comparator are required for a scoped superiority statement; disclose individual family differences, empirical sample scope, and all comparisons. With fewer families, results are descriptive only. Seed 98031, 10,000 family resamples. No wins from metadata alone. Do not tune or reinterpret failures, expose reserve outcomes, or replace an assessment corpus after inspection.
